INSERT INTO software_catalog (package_name, ecosystem)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.vulnerabilities.package.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.vulnerabilities.package.ecosystem.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (package_name, ecosystem)
DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = NOW();

SELECT 
    sc.id, 
    COALESCE(a.name, sc.name) AS asset_name, 
    sc.software, 
    sc.ecosystem, 
    sc.version, 
    e.name AS env_name, 
    e.business_criticality AS env_criticality
FROM software_components sc
LEFT JOIN assets a ON sc.asset_id = a.id
JOIN environments e ON a.environment_id = e.id
WHERE sc.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND LOWER(TRIM(sc.software)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.vulnerabilities.package.name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
  AND LOWER(TRIM(sc.ecosystem)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.vulnerabilities.package.ecosystem.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'))
  AND (
      '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'TODOS' 
      OR e.name = '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  )
  AND (
      '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'TODOS' 
      OR a.name = '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      OR sc.name = '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  );

INSERT INTO public.vulnerabilities_audit 
(
    detected_at, 
    asset_id,
    scan_id,
    cve_id, 
    ghsa_id, 
    cvss, 
    exploited, 
    priority, 
    assigned_to, 
    status,
    patched_version,
    is_zero_day,
    software,
    ecosystem,
    version,
    priority_variables,
    advisory_type,
    vulnerable_version_range
) 
VALUES (
    NOW(), 
    {{ $json.id || $json.asset_id || 0 }}, -- Intenta con 'id', si no 'asset_id', y si no pone 0 para que no sea undefined
    {{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.scan_id ? $("Edit Fields").first().json.scan_id : 'NULL' }},
    '{{ $json.cve_id || "N/A" }}', 
    '{{ $json.ghsa_id }}', 
    '{{ $json.cvss }}', 
    {{ $json.is_cisa_kev ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }}, 
    '{{ $json.priority }}', 
    'SIN_ASIGNAR', 
    'DETECTADA',
    {{ $json.patch_version && $json.patch_version !== 'N/A' ? `'${$json.patch_version.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL' }}, -- NULL en vez de 'N/A' -- el frontend distingue "sin parche" via is_zero_day, no parseando texto
    {{ $json.is_zero_day ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
    {{ $json.software ? `'${$json.software.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL' }}, -- A-NUEVO-1 (docs/20-08-26/AUDITORIA_END_TO_END_2.md): snapshot de que estaba instalado al detectar, para que el historial no se reescriba si el componente cambia despues
    {{ $json.ecosystem ? `'${$json.ecosystem.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.version_instalada ? `'${$json.version_instalada.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.priority_variables ? `'${$json.priority_variables.replace(/'/g, "''")}'::jsonb` : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.advisory_type ? `'${$json.advisory_type.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL' }},
    {{ $json.vulnerable_version_range ? `'${$json.vulnerable_version_range.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL' }}
);

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    LOWER(TRIM(sc.software)) AS software,
    LOWER(TRIM(sc.ecosystem)) AS ecosystem
FROM software_components sc
JOIN assets a ON sc.asset_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN environments e ON a.environment_id = e.id
WHERE sc.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND LOWER(TRIM(sc.ecosystem)) IN (SELECT LOWER(TRIM(name)) FROM public.ecosystems)
  AND (
      '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'TODOS'
      OR e.name = '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_entorno.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  )
  AND (
      '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' = 'TODOS'
      OR a.name = '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
      OR sc.name = '{{ $("Edit Fields").first().json.filtro_activo.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
  );
